title: Multi-Agent Self-Improving Reinforcement Learning for Video Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.28675v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video reasoning tasks such as grounded video question answering and temporal grounding require selecting temporal evidence that supports the query. In many current training setups, temporal supervision is applied through local objectives such as boundary regression or span generation, while verification is used mainly to rerank candidate segments at inference time. We study whether a frozen verifier can also guide training. Our multi-agent framework couples a trainable \emph{Grounder} with a frozen \emph{Verifier}: the Grounder samples candidate trajectories and evidence segments, the Verifier assigns query-conditioned segment scores, a group-relative policy-gradient objective favors trajectories that outperform their within-input peers, and a bootstrapped calibration loss steers temporal predictions toward verifier-preferred spans. translated_title: 面向视频推理的多智能体自我改进强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.28675v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：诸如接地视频问答和时序定位等视频推理任务需要选择能够支持查询的时序证据。在当前的许多训练设置中，时序监督是通过边界回归或片段生成等局部目标来施加的，而验证主要用于推理阶段对候选片段进行重排序。我们研究冻结的验证器是否也能用于指导训练。我们的多智能体框架将一个可训练的“定位器”与一个冻结的“验证器”相耦合：定位器采样候选轨迹和证据片段，验证器给出基于查询的片段评分，组相对策略梯度目标会偏好优于同输入内其他候选的轨迹，而自举校准损失则将时序预测引导向验证器所偏好的片段。在源任务上训练并在不进行目标数据集微调的情况下进行评估，一个二十亿参数的实例……
tldr: 该论文提出一种多智能体自我改进强化学习框架，将可训练的定位器与冻结的验证器耦合，通过组相对策略梯度与自举校准损失让验证器信号直接指导训练，从而在无需目标数据集微调的情况下提升视频推理中时序证据的选择能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agent self-improving reinforcement learning framework that couples a trainable Grounder with a frozen Verifier, using group-relative policy gradients and a bootstrapped calibration loss to let verifier signals guide training, thereby improving temporal evidence selection for video reasoning without target-dataset fine-tuning.
